title: fix(deps): resolve eslint peer conflict and bump apidom to 5.1.0

raw.title: fix(deps): resolve eslint peer conflict and bump apidom to 5.1.0
raw.body:
## Summary

- Fixes a broken \`npm install\` (\`ERESOLVE\`) caused by #19, which bumped \`@eslint/js\` to \`10.0.1\` without bumping \`eslint\` — \`@eslint/js@10.x\` peer-requires \`eslint@^10.0.0\`, but \`eslint\` was still pinned at \`^9.39.1\`.
- Bumps \`eslint\` to \`^10.0.0\` (\`typescript-eslint@^8.34.0\` already supports it) and regenerates \`package-lock.json\`.
- Bumps all \`@speclynx/apidom-*\` dependencies (parser, runner, resolver, validator) from \`^5.0.1\` to \`^5.1.0\`. \`@speclynx/apidom-ls\` is left untouched (separate \`2.x\` line).

## Verification

- \`npm i\` completes cleanly under Node \`26.3.1\`
- \`npm run build\` — all 4 packages build successfully
- \`npm run test\` — 528 passing, no regressions
- \`npx eslint --version\` → \`10.8.1\`
